project_type: pnpm/Turbo TypeScript monorepo with Next.js 15 App Router web app, core/types/controllers packages, local-first and SQL repositories
build_system: pnpm workspaces with Turbo; web uses Next.js; SQL uses JSONB question columns and Neon inline recordsets
verification_instructions: Run focused Vitest tests during each feature, package typechecks, then pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm build; perform a browser/runtime smoke check for /review/test/<quizId>.
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/web build generates .next and scripts/generate-version.mjs output; do not commit generated build artifacts unless existing workflow requires it.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace; external database/browser credentials may be unavailable and must be documented rather than treated as passing runtime evidence.
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing non-enumeration behavior, public answer-key privacy, numeric enumeration answer_text semantics, and commit locally without pushing.
key_patterns: Question normalization is centralized in packages/core/src/repositories/questionFields.ts; public projection is packages/core/src/security/publicDtos.ts; practice route is the loader/mastery template; existing review/[quizId] is flashcard-only; QuizStartConfigModal owns study-mode navigation.
directory_structure: packages/types contains models/DTOs; packages/core contains repositories, security, schema; apps/web contains App Router routes, quiz components/hooks/lib; sql/schema.sql is the canonical DDL.
